snippet: Distributed Orpheus Acoustic Testing results (2nd round).
Delivered 'to_MASS_05_15_08.zip' to vendor for quoting 1-10 units.
Established schedule with Argyle: 20-30 prototype units required by late July.
Mechanical Project Meeting: 'Ugly Build' target slipped to July 22.
Loaded chassis files (Base, PCB Bracket, Fan Tray) for release to 8/1 build.
EMI pre-scan passed Radiated Emissions with 2nd round metals.
First Article Inspection (FAI) Report generated for Orpheus Fan Mounts.
Initial Thermal Test conducted at 24°C; fans at 100% maxing CPU.
Submitted ECO 000708 releasing Orpheus sheetmetal and plastics to Production.
EMI Scan failure; requires addition of four extra screws to pass.
Loaded and released KDISK-M blanking plate (501-1132-00) on ECO 734.
Glow quality crisis: 'Does not look good.' Proposal to remove 5 LEDs.
Proposed mechanical spacing fix for 'blobby' glow (glow_12_29_08.pdf).
Thermal Crisis: Orpheus units hard hanging every 50 minutes (missing thermal paste).
Proposed design change for IR lens to match Mercury shape.
'Thumb of God': 5 of 13 AV boards damaged by tray screw hole during assembly.
Pilot assembly suspended due to system functional test failures.
Crisis Meeting: 'Sanmina spinning up production engine and now at a dead stop.'
Decision to delay launch to ensure FCC compliance (missing grounding spring).
Official Orpheus (Mini System) Launch Announcement.
OOBE Inspection Report: 'Foot not flush', 'Debris flecks', 'Vinyl tape work-around'.
KDISK Alignment Issue: Cartridges not aligned, bias downward and left.
Reported 'Power Button Sticks' issue; silicone not concentric with sheetmetal.
Resistor rework identified to fix 'blotchiness' in glow voltage drop.
Request Sanmina inspect 20 pieces for dimple height and punching flash.
Released Sheet Metal DFx ECO to clean up production issues.
